about: Third-party skills, plugins and MCP servers UMS works with. Each is pinned to the commit read on the date given, with its licence. UMS does not vendor any of them: it routes to them when they are installed and prints the exact install command when they are not. A person runs the install; UMS never installs, enables or disables another plugin by itself.

packs.name: Corey Haines marketingskills
packs.domain: conversion and growth depth: CRO, pricing, paywalls, onboarding, referrals, programmatic SEO, schema, ASO, cold email
packs.routes: UMS owns social, video and autonomy; hand page-conversion, pricing and lifecycle depth to these skills when installed.
packs.notes: Strip the README's partner and referral links if adapting anything. Its X algorithm reference tags claims as verified or reported, the same rule UMS follows.

packs.name: Anthropic marketing plugin (knowledge-work-plugins)
packs.domain: campaign briefs, performance reports, brand review, email sequences, and its connectors to HubSpot, Canva, Ahrefs, Similarweb, Klaviyo, Amplitude, Notion, Figma, Slack, Supermetrics
packs.routes: If installed, its connectors are the data source for ums report work. UMS's own campaign and copy rules replace its generic social guidance (it gives no platform limits).
packs.notes: Installed in Claude (Cowork) and Claude Code through the plugin directory.

packs.name: ECC content and social skills
packs.domain: voice profiles from real writing, crossposting adaptation, X API recipes, footage editing, fal.ai media generation
packs.routes: UMS's voice and crosspost rules draw on these; its own queue, policy and ffmpeg engine replace their direct-posting steps.
packs.notes: social-publisher in ECC depends on a paid third-party service (SocialClaw); UMS does not route to it.

packs.name: HeyGen HyperFrames
packs.domain: HTML to video for motion-heavy promos; needs Node 22+ and ffmpeg
packs.routes: Use for animated product promos made of web pages; UMS's ffmpeg engine covers slideshows, captions and exports.

packs.name: Remotion skills
packs.license: none found at this commit; Remotion itself is free for teams of three or fewer people, company licence otherwise (remotion.dev/license)
packs.domain: React-based programmatic video; captions, multimedia, rendering
packs.routes: Linked, not vendored. Ultimate Frontend Skills ships a remotion-video skill with an original example; prefer that route when UFS is installed.
packs.notes: Check the company licence before a business renders with Remotion.

packs.name: Ultimate Frontend Skills
packs.domain: landing pages, store pages, link-preview share cards, image deep research, Remotion video, motion, sound
packs.routes: UMS's sister plugin. Landing pages and free tools are built with UFS; share cards with its link-preview skill; reference images with image-deep-research.
packs.notes: Same author. Install both; neither disables the other.

packs.name: MJML email HTML skill (framix-team)
packs.domain: complex email layouts compiled with MJML (needs the mjml npm package)
packs.routes: Use when a design needs layouts beyond the UMS builder (multi-column product grids); run ums email check on the result.

packs.name: Email design archetypes (CosmoBlk)
packs.domain: six committed email design archetypes, brand-aware
packs.routes: Borrow a layout archetype for a brand-heavy campaign; build it with ums email build.

packs.name: AI Marketing Suite (zubair-trabzada)
packs.domain: 15 marketing skills with parallel subagents: audits and reports
packs.routes: Site and funnel audits run in parallel; UMS turns the findings into the calendar and queue.

packs.name: OpenClaudia marketing skills
packs.routes: Wide coverage for niche jobs UMS does not own; install only the skills a job needs.

packs.name: Marketing OS (Yuzzyuk)
packs.routes: A scored audit before a campaign; UMS acts on the lowest scores first.

packs.name: Postiz (self-hosted scheduler)
packs.domain: self-hosted scheduling to 14 platforms, with an MCP server
packs.routes: Hand approved queue items to a self-hosted Postiz for platforms without a UMS API route. AGPL: run it as a separate service; do not copy its code into UMS.

packs.name: Canva plugin (official)
packs.domain: Canva skills on top of the Canva MCP server: on-brand designs, resizes, exports
packs.install: /plugin marketplace add canva-sdks/canva-skills then /plugin install canva@canva-skills
packs.routes: Prefer this over the bare Canva server for carousels, thumbnails and ad sizes; it does not publish to social.

packs.name: Figma plugin (official)
packs.license: no licence file; Figma Developer Terms apply
packs.domain: Figma skills and MCP server for design-system work
packs.routes: Ad and thumbnail variants from a design system. Route to it; do not copy its skills.

packs.name: Supermetrics marketing plugin (official)
packs.domain: 21 skills over ad and social data; reports read-only, writes need approval, new campaigns created paused
packs.routes: The weekly results report (references/measure.md) pulls from it when installed.

packs.name: Amplitude plugin (official)
packs.domain: 28 skills for product analytics: activation, retention, funnels
packs.routes: Use for what happens after the click (activation, retention) in the weekly report.

packs.name: Resend skills (official)
packs.domain: five skills for sending and managing email through Resend
packs.routes: Send approved emails built with ums email build; UMS checks first.

packs.name: Notion plugin (official)
packs.domain: 12 skills including campaign planning in Notion
packs.routes: Write the calendar and briefs where the team already plans.

packs.name: Apollo plugin (official)
packs.domain: prospect, enrich lead, load sequence (previews before bulk add), analytics
packs.routes: Finding prospects for the sales playbook. Never let it load or send sequences without the person approving each message batch; it spends Apollo credits.

mcpTooling.name: Claude Code tool search
mcpTooling.what: On by default: tool definitions load when needed instead of all at start. Keep it on when several marketing MCP servers are connected.

mcpTooling.name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
mcpTooling.what: MCP output is capped at 25,000 tokens (warning at 10,000). Ask analytics servers for aggregates, not raw rows, rather than raising the cap.

mcpTooling.name: Code execution with MCP
mcpTooling.what: Anthropic (4 Nov 2025): calling MCP tools from code instead of loading every definition cut one workflow from 150,000 to 2,000 tokens. UMS scripts follow the same idea: data stays in files, the model reads summaries.

mcpTooling.name: MCP Inspector
mcpTooling.what: Test a server's tools and outputs before trusting it in a run.

mcpTooling.name: Docker MCP Gateway
mcpTooling.what: Runs local MCP servers in containers behind one endpoint, with secrets kept out of the model.

mcpTooling.name: Cisco MCP Scanner
mcpTooling.what: Scans server tool descriptions for poisoning and risky instructions before install.
